programme.title: Wild Fire
programme.desc: Dream Town Development real estate bosses Jack Del Rio and Sy Richards can't convince animal lover Carol Tanner to sell and relocate safari/animal retirement ranch Wild Land, which she runs with younger sister Ballad since their parents died in a plane crash. Jack hires Bradshaw and Roach to release tiger Caesar, after that fails to cause a scandal to start a forest fire and release all animals, after tying up Carol. Ballad's lover, committed Glendora, southern California fire captain Kennedy, and his jumper team try their best to control the fire. Meanwhile young sheriff Drake Donovan and Ballad drug and catch wild animals. The arson is discovered, but the fiends aren't done yet.

programme.title: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
The Year Dolly Parton Was My Mom
programme.desc: Elizabeth Alison Gray is just your average suburban 11-year old waiting for adolescence to arrive when she finds out her whole life has been a lie. With only her imagination to guide her, she runs away to find the truth.

programme.title: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret
High Crimes
programme.desc: Legal thriller, starring Ashley Judd, Morgan Freeman and Jim Caviezel. A high-powered lawyer's world is turned upside down when the man she knew as her husband Tom, is arrested. It emerges his real name is Ron Chapman, and he is thought to be responsible for a war crime during his time in the Marines. As he goes to trial, his wife grapples with the military justice system and calls on the somewhat unconventional Charlie Grimes for help to restore her husband's reputation. Adam Scott also features.

programme.title: Hit List
programme.desc: Charlotte is a woman with anger management issues whose therapist suggests she write a journal to keep her emotions in check. Unlucky in love, she ventures online to find a boyfriend. Just as she reaches her limit of unsuccessful dates, Charlotte meets her soul mate Lyle. Everything is perfect until Lyle finds Charlottes journal and sets out to prove just how deeply he loves her.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: Here is a surgeon. He can't practice medicine anymore because he has panic attacks, while reliving a surgery gone bad. His wife is a medical malpractice attorney who picks up a case from a woman who was her husband's nurse.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Land Of the Blind
programme.desc: A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

programme.title: The Howling: Reborn
programme.desc: In the sequel to The Howling. On the eve of his high school graduation, unremarkable Will Kidman finally bonds with the girl he has long yearned for, reclusive Eliana Wynter. But he also discovers a dark secret from his past... that he is about to become a werewolf. 1 Jul 13, in an effort to fight destiny and save their love as well as their lives, they must battle not only Will's growing blood lust but an army of fearsome beasts bent on killing them... and then, us all.

programme.title: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Two cop partners, who are also best friends attend a domestic disturbance, only for one to accidentaly critically wound the other. The rest of the police force are suspicious that there may have been no accident.

programme.title: El camino
programme.desc: Elliot, 31, a product of the Washington D.C. foster care system, has spent most of his life moving from place to place. When he is contacted by Matthew, a childhood friend from "the system" dying of cancer, Elliot goes to be by his side. At the funeral, he meets Gray and Lily, two friends of Matthew, both aimless in their present lives. Motivated by their sense of loss, and personal anger, Gray, Lily and Elliot steal Matthew's ashes and take them to Mexico. As the three travelers journey cross-country with Matthew's urn in tow, they are forced to confront their own sense of family, identity and future. Set against the changing American landscape, EL CAMINO follows these characters as they search for themselves in a country that has lost it's own identity. Gray, the wayward son of a prominent D.C. family, has left his pregnant girlfriend. He is angry, volatile and fearful of commitment. Lily is Matthew's ex-girlfriend. Unbeknownst to her parents, she has dropped out of college and become an exotic dancer. Lost in alcohol and pills she longs for her mother's approval. Elliot is outside the cultural mainstream. He carries a suitcase filled with documents and mementos of his life. An explorer of human experience, he interviews and videotapes people he meets. Haunted by dreams of his mother's drowning, Elliot struggles to find his place in the world. EL CAMINO is a humorous and compassionate film about friendship, family, and search for self in today's American landscape

programme.title: Imaginary Heroes
programme.desc: A shocking and tragic event causes the members of a quietly dysfunctional family to reexamine themselves and their lives in this drama. Ben and Sandy Travis (Jeff Daniels and Sigourney Weaver) are a couple whose troubled family begins to crumble when their eldest son, star college athlete Matt (Kip Pardue) commits suicide. Sandy's naturally cynical nature becomes all the more prickly, and while she tries to bond with her surviving teenaged son, Tim (Emile Hirsch), they seem closest when they discover a shared fondness for marijuana. Ben also tries to reach out to Tim, but the young man is never able to shake the feeling that he's never quite been the son his father wanted. Tim has a girlfriend, Steph (Suzanne Santo), but their relationship has been going through a rocky patch, and Tim finds himself questioning his feelings about women and men when his friendship with next-door neighbor Kyle (Ryan Donowho) evolves into something more intimate.

programme.title: Opasna vožnja
programme.desc: Noć u Los Anđelesu pretvara se u psihološki rat za opstanak kada Uber vozač Džejms i putnica Džesika pokupe harizmatičnog, ali manipulativnog Bruna.

programme.title: Slepa opsednutost
programme.desc: U pucnjavi u kojoj su učestvovala dvojica braće iz kriminalnog miljea, policajac Džek Flečer gubi vid. Tokom oporavka, pomaže mu Rebeka, trener za nedavno oslepele. Postepeno, Džek i Rebeka se zaljubljuju jedno u drugo, uprkos protivljenju Rebekine sestre Bedelije, koja je u detinjstvu, kao žrtva incesta, razvila patološku mržnju prema muškarcima. Kad mu se vid vrati, Džek shvata da je meta dvoje potencijalnih ubica: lude sestre Bedelije, ili brata kriminalca kog je ubio.

programme.title: Ubistvena igra
programme.desc: Tajni tim ubica pod imenom "Senke", stavljen je na test u igri preživljavanja.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Tinejdžerka tajni agent
programme.desc: Žestoki, snalažljivi privatni detektiv, pristaje da u okviru istrage FBI bude deo tajnog zadatka unutar bratstva na koledžu.

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi i sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec
programme.desc: Par se venčava na Havajima i za medeni mesec polaze na krstarenje, ali stvari kreću užasno loše

programme.title: Loša genetika
programme.desc: Žena koja je ostavljena jedanaest puta, otkriva (na svoje zaprepašćenje) da ima gubitničke ljubavne gene.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi lajk
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka dobija zadatak da piše o zavodniku sa dejting aplikacija, ali ubrzo otkriva da se iza njegove reputacije krije mnogo više od onoga što je očekivala.

programme.title: Olimpijski snovi
programme.desc: U Olimpijskom selu sportista mlada skijašica se zbližava sa volonterom dok se završava njen takmičarski nastup.

programme.title: Disko
programme.desc: Didje je četrdesetogodišnjak _ fan disko muzike. Muškarac nema posla i još uvek živi sa majkom. Didje ima sina, kojeg dugo nije video, ipak njegova majka ne slaže se da zajedno provedu odmor. Didje odlučuje da pobedi u plesnom konkursu, da dobije nagradu i da povede sina na nezaboravni odmor u Australiju. Muškarac nagovara svoje prijatelje da mu pomognu. Zapošljavaju trenera, koji treba da ih pripremi za takmičenje. Brzo se uspostavlja, da makar nekad bili su odlični plesači, vreme je uradilo svoje. Moraju puno da rade da bi nastupili.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: Dok hiljade ljudi na prepunom Vembliju oduševljeno pozdravljaju Ruju Ignatovu, ona gradi imidž "Kraljice kripta" i obećava finansijsku revoluciju. Iza blještavila i uspeha krije se žena opsednuta bogatstvom i statusom, čiji će san ubrzo prerasti u jednu od najvećih prevara modernog doba.

programme.title: Sponzor
programme.desc: Kada muzičarka koja jedva sastavlja kraj s krajem ne može da plati kiriju, prijavljuje se na sajt na kojem bogati stariji muškarci plaćaju da izlaze s mlađim ženama. Novi izvor zarade uvlači je u mračni vrtlog koji je primorava da brzo odraste i menja njenu muziku i pogled na svet.

programme.title: Još uvek smo tu
programme.desc: Kristijan Bejker, mladi novinar iz Njujorka, dobija zadatak da piše o nestanku dvanaestogodišnje Monik Votson iz Bruklina. Neozbiljan početak vodi u niz problema, a osećaj krivice ga primorava da krene u trku s vremenom kako bi pomogao porodici da pronađe devojčicu.

programme.title: Igra u četvoro
programme.desc: Kerol (Alis Taljoni), ilustratorka knjiga za decu, ugovara pregled kod ginekologa. Pokazuje se da je ginekolog poznanik Lajonel (Fransoa Kluzet). Kerol i Lajonel tokom tog pregleda slučajno otkrivaju da njihove partnere veže ljubavnički odnos. Oboje žele da spasu svoje veze. Zato se dogovaraju da će učiniti sve kako bi povratili svoje partnere. Kako bi ostvarili cilj koriste se različitim metodima i načinima, često smešnim. Uskoro nešto dublje počinje povezivati Kerol i Lajonela. Osveta je slatka.

programme.title: Igra u četvoro
programme.desc: Kerol (Alis Taljoni), ilustratorka knjiga za decu, ugovara pregled kod ginekologa. Pokazuje se da je ginekolog poznanik Lajonel (Fransoa Kluzet). programme.title: Devojka broj jedan
programme.desc: Producent, režiser i akciona zvezda; to je sve što vam je potrebno da snimite najbolji film svih vremena. Zar ne?

programme.title: Pad Amerike
programme.desc: Kada bivšeg marinca optuže za smrtonosni teroristički napad, on mora da pronađe glavnog organizatora zavere. Međutim, uskoro otkriva još smrtonosniju zaveru koja preti celoj naciji, a on će biti primoran da bira između slobode miliona građana i sopstvenog opstanka.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Deset stvari koje bi trebalo da uradimo pre raskida
programme.desc: Kada Ebigejl, samohrana majka dvoje dece, zatrudni nakon jedne noći provedene s Benom, ovaj neobični par pokušaće da se izbori s novonastalom situacijom.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Mrvica i rudnik zlata
programme.desc: Nakon ponovnog ujedinjenja s porodicom, Mrvica se teško navikava na luksuzan život. Kada ga otme stari neprijatelj, mora upotrebiti najbolje stečeno znanje iz novog i starog života, kako bi pobegao i spasao svoje roditelje.

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstva.

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Ukradena dolina
programme.desc: Da bi spasila život svojoj majci, meksičko-navaho mehaničarka udružuje snage s odmetnicom kako bi se suprotstavile korumpiranom zemljoposedniku.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Draga Elizabet
programme.desc: Muškarac koji vodi dosadan život slučajno počinje da proganja staru koleginicu s fakulteta, glumicu Elizabet Benks, na društvenim mrežama. U svojim pokušajima da dokaže da je poznaje, ponovo otkriva sebe i pravo značenje prijateljstva.

programme.title: Savršena žena

programme.title: Veliki medved
programme.desc: "Big Bear" je priča o Džou, koji nevoljno odlazi na svoje momačko veče iako ga je verenica upravo ostavila zbog nekog tipa.

programme.title: Banda iz Osa
programme.desc: Johana želi da promeni svoj život i napusti kriminalne bande u gradu Osu tokom 30-ih godina 20. veka, ali što se više trudi, sve se više upliće.

programme.title: Nedozvoljeno

programme.title: Australijski gangster
programme.desc: Paskal Barbaro (Aleksandar Bertran) izlazi iz zatvora, ali tek kada razvije neprijateljstvo s članom grupe "Braća zauvek", Malim Ludakom (Rahel Roman). Les Elijas (Salvatore Koko) predlaže Barbaru da se poveže s Farhadom "Avganistanskim guruom" (Majkl Vajs), novim vođom grupe "Braća zauvek", koji mrzi Malog Ludaka, i da njihov sukob pretvori u sopstvenu korist.

programme.title: Noćna tabla

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Kralj boraca

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi

Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi i sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se održati svoju pekaru, ali jednog dana je izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora prisiljava na zatvaranje posla. Meri sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati ka svojoj porodici u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću Brent dobija napad alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Meri odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to da bude dobra ideja?

programme.title: Tinejdžerka tajni agent
programme.desc: Žestoki, snalažljivi privatni detektiv, pristaje da u okviru istrage FBI bude deo tajnog zadatka unutar bratstva na koledžu.

programme.desc: Na turneji po Britaniji 1926. godine, Hari Hudini započinje strastvenu vezu sa vidovnjakinjom koja namerava da prevari sjajnog mađioničara.

programme.title: Šta sve radimo za ljubav
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: Sofija postaje središte Rujinog sve moćnijeg poslovnog carstva. Pod sloganom "Jedan novčić, jedna porodica", okuplja milione sledbenika i gradi privid zajedništva i uspeha. Međutim, iza sjaja, bogatstva i obećanja o brzom bogaćenju kriju se manipulacije, pohlepa i sve jasniji znaci da se čitava imperija zasniva na obmani.

programme.title: Spasavanje Boga
programme.desc: Bivši robijaš, sada sveštenik, vraća se u opasan kraj kako bi preuzeo očevu crkvu i pomagao mladima da se izvuku iz sveta droge i bandi. Pokušavajući da spase jednog problematičnog tinejdžera, primoran je da se i sam izbori sa nasilnom prošlošću i iskušenjima koja ga vuku unazad.

programme.title: Uništiteljka
programme.desc: Policijska detektivka ponovo se nalazi sa ljudima s kojima je davno radila na tajnom zadatku, kako bi među njima konačno došlo do pomirenja.

programme.title: Ne voli me
programme.desc: Usamljeni romanopisac pokušava da pronađe ljubav i smisao života uprkos katastrofalnim i komičnim situacijama.

programme.desc: When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.

programme.title: Quelqu'un derricre la porte
programme.desc: A neurosurgeon with a cheating wife takes an amnesiac into his home and conditions him to believe that the cheating wife is his own and to take the "appropriate" action.

programme.title: Psycho-Circus
programme.desc: A circus becomes the location for stolen loot and murder.

programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: Too Late for Tears
programme.desc: Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.

programme.title: Answer Me
programme.desc: The love story of a couple which, after the marriage and the birth of the first son, turns into hell. Taken from the novel Rispondimi by Susanna Tamaro.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: A biopic dramatizing Abraham Lincoln's life through a series of vignettes depicting its defining chapters: his romance with Ann Rutledge; his early years as a country lawyer; his marriage to Mary Todd; his debates with Stephen A. Douglas; the election of 1860; his presidency during the Civil War; and his assassination in Ford's Theater in 1865.

programme.title: People Are Funny
programme.desc: A comedy based on NBC's "People Are Funny" radio (and later television) program with Art Linkletter with a fictional story of how the program came to be on a national network from its humble beginning at a Nevada radio station. Jack Haley is a producer with only half-rights to the program while Ozzie Nelson and Helen Walker are the radio writers and supply the romance. Rudy Vallee, always able to burlesque himself intentional and, quite often, unintentional, is the owner of the sought-after sponsoring company. Frances Langford, as herself, sings "I'm in the Mood for Love" while the Vagabonds quartet (billed 12th and last) chimes in on "Angeline" and "The Old Square Dance is Back Again."

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Secret Service agents make a deal with a counterfeiting inmate to be released on early parole if he will help them recover some bogus moneymaking plates, but he plans to double cross them.

programme.desc: Fanni has had enough of money and Anna has had enough of pigs. Fanni leaves the city and her pearls behind, while Anna is stuck wearing muddy overalls. When they finally cross paths, they embark on a punk adventure towards Marxist liberty.

programme.title: Private Buckaroo
programme.desc: A rebellious young inductee has trouble toeing the line until he meets a retired officer's lovely daughter. James and his band are also drafted and decide to perk up their camp by putting on a big show.

programme.title: Hell's House
programme.desc: Jimmy idolizes bootlegger Matt, and when he refuses to implicate his friend, he is sent to reform school. He befriends Shorty, a boy with a heart condition, and escapes to let the world know about the brutal conditions.

programme.title: The Fatal Hour
programme.desc: When a police officer is murdered, Captain Street looks to Mr. Wong to catch the killer. Prime Suspect: Frank Belden Jr., whose father is a businessman well known for both his success and dishonesty. Mr. Wong faces increasing danger and is nearly executed himself as the investigation develops in treachery and complexity. As Mr. Wong follows the trail of dead bodies, he uncovers a jewel smuggling ring on the San Francisco waterfront and a case much larger than the death of a police officer.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Secret Police
programme.desc: Captain Drummond and his girlfriend want to marry but a hidden treasure in the house in which they want to celebrate their marriage is complicating the situation involving a series of deaths and an elusive murderer.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A teenaged girl witnesses her widowed mother's attempt to sustain her family.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

Brennan/Talbot are twin brothers (one a casino owner, the other a rancher) and Hoppy believes they provide alibis for each other while one is out committing crimes. Hoppy gets a job in the casino to learn more but is exposed when a gambling gunslinger notices him.

programme.title: Captain Calamity
programme.desc: A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.

programme.desc: After their airplane crashes behind enemy lines, four soldiers must survive and try to find a way back to their battalion. However, when they come across a local peasant girl the horrors of war quickly become apparent.

programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.

programme.title: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: Seven guests, a newly hired personal secretary and two staff are gathered for a weekend on an isolated island by the hosts the Owens who are delayed. At dinner a record is played and the host's message alleges that all the people present are guilty of murder and suddenly the first of them is dead, then the next _ It seems that one of them is the murderer but the leading person is always the person who is murdered next and at last only two people are left.

programme.title: The Naked Kiss
programme.desc: Kelly, a prostitute, traumatised by an experience, referred to as "The Naked Kiss," by psychiatrists, leaves her past, and finds solace in the town of Grantville. She meets Griff, the police captain of the town, with whom she spends a romantic afternoon. Kelly finds a job as a nurse in a hospital for handicapped children. The work helps her find her sensitive side in the caring and helping of her young patients. Kelly's path towards happiness is thrown amiss, when she witnesses a shocking event, which threatens not just her happiness, but her mental health as well.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Father of the bride faces becoming a grandfather.

programme.desc: Terrified of being buried alive by mistake, a woman puts a phone in her crypt to be able to call home if she needs help. She dies and nothing happens. One day, the phone suddenly rings. Paranormal investigator Nelson Orion is brought in.

She "covers" the inquest of the death of a woman who was poisoned. Nancy doesn't think the young woman accused of the crime is guilty and corrals her neighbor Ted into searching for a vital piece of evidence and stumbles onto the identity of the real killer.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

Director Ewald Andre Dupont took almost a year to make Moulin Rouge at a production cost of $500,000, a huge amount for 1928.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: A fictional account of the 1958 attack against the Hungarian embassy in Bern. Based on a true story about the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian revolution.

programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.desc: The wealthy and impulsive Rollo Treadway decides to propose to his beautiful socialite neighbor, Betsy O'Brien. Although Betsy turns Rollo down, he still opts to go on the cruise that he intended as their honeymoon.

programme.title: It's a Joke, Son!
programme.desc: Claghorn gets into some financial difficulties and is forced by a machine-political gang to enter a race for state senator against his wife (Una Merkel) who appears to have a good chance to beat the political hack backed by the machine. Claghorn is in to siphon votes and ensure his wife's opponent will win and is expected to run a campaign that will defeat himself and his wife. But, he runs to win and the machine's henchies abduct him.

Their daughter Patricia blends clips from 10 game shows with vintage footage, motion graphics, and music to create an intimate portrait of her quirky parents. Through love, hardship, ambition, and humor, the film captures a unique family story and a revealing slice of 20th-century life, culminating in Bernard's words: "If it's a lucky life, it's mine.

programme.desc: Two sisters find out the existence of their long-lost mother, but the younger cannot take the truth of being abandoned as a child.

programme.desc: Fifth Avenue socialite Irene Bullock needs a "forgotten man" to win a scavenger hunt, and no one is more forgotten than Godfrey Park, who resides in a dump by the East River. Irene hires Godfrey as a servant for her riotously unhinged family, to the chagrin of her spoiled sister, Cornelia, who tries her best to get Godfrey fired. As Irene falls for her new butler, Godfrey turns the tables and teaches the frivolous Bullocks a lesson or two.

programme.title: Christmas Wish
programme.desc: A little squirrel with lots of charm accidentally helps two poor, down-but-NOT-out families overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: Gesture
programme.desc: Ali learns through medical documents the sudden recurrence of his son's incurable genetic disorder. Deciding to hide the matter from the rest of the family, he finds himself helpless and starts behaving strangely.

programme.desc: Set in post-war Japan, The Lady of Musashino tells the story of Michiko, a disillusioned young woman trapped in a loveless marriage. She confides in her younger cousin, Tsutomo, and the two become close, but decide not to consummate their affair. He instead becomes involved with the flirtatious Tomiko, who is also conducting an affair with Michiko's husband. When Michiko finds that her husband has abandoned her, she decides to take her fate into her own hands.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Medical history is full of odd cures—like bloodletting, which still helps in rare cases. Germs were once doubted until a doctor spotted bacteria between his teeth. Fleming later discovered antibiotics by accident. But now, "superbugs" threaten this miracle cure. Refrigeration, once deadly due to toxic gases, evolved thanks to pressure-cooking and may soon use sound waves. From leeches to lab breakthroughs, medicine keeps evolving—what's next?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Water covers 71% of the Earth's surface and is the medium of life. All life forms and their surrounding ecosystems are dependent upon water, without it we would cease to exist. Director of Notre Dame's Environmental Change Initiative, Dr. David Lodge examines the infestations that are spreading throughout our fresh and salt water systems and clogging our precious waterways.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we focus on nuclear and industrial disasters. Nuclear power, based on fission or fusion, is a clean energy source—but when safety fails, consequences can be catastrophic. Industrial accidents are tragic enough, but when natural disasters like earthquakes or volcanoes strike nuclear facilities, the results can be off the scale and last for decades. This chilling look reminds us that vigilance and responsibility are vital to prevent the unthinkable.

programme.title: Rip Files

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Bienvenido a Miami! We take a look at the history behind Florida's modern metropolis. We visit the Ancient Spanish Monastery, see the opulence of the Vizcaya Museum and Gardens, and head into the swamp to learn about the Miccosukee indians.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Un-Belizable! We're off on a Central American Mayan excursion. We head up the steps of the ancient high temple at Lamanai. Then we take a city tour of the main tourist destination, Belize City. We learn about Belize's colonial roots at the Belize City History Museum and dive the amazing Blue Hole.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Chasing big Chinook Salmon just outside Rivers Inlet, BC from Duncanby Lodge!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Whether you refer to Udaipur as the City of Lakes or the City of Dawn, you are sure to agree that romance and beauty fill the air. While traveling by boat, we visit the many palaces and temples on the shore. We also tour the majestic City Palace and the Garden of the Maids of Honor. In Jaipur, we tour the Pink City, paying close attention to such architectural treasures as the Palace of Winds (Hawa Mahal) and the Amber Fort. We also visit the magnificent collections housed in the City Palace.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Caves have held a special place in human development. The Hindu, Buddhist and Jain caves in these two UNESCO sites contain some of the most beautiful carvings and paintings found in Asia. This episode explores the history and relationship between these religions.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Gold, ivory and slaves drove the economy of the East coast of Africa 500 years ago. Join us as we explore the Portuguese and Arab roles in these horrific trade schemes. We'll also investigate the pristine waters off the coast of the nearby National Park where our host dons a snorkel mask and comes face-to-face with the creatures of the coral reef.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Few people know that Gandhi got his political activist start in South Africa. This is a city where Asia meets Africa and is one of the most diverse cities in the world. Here Journeys encounters people of European, Far Eastern and Indian descent as well as the local Zulus.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: First people to free ski big mountain lines in Japan. Long travel times to Japan and ski opportunities were not the only obstacles on their way to explore Japan's backcountry.

programme.title: Nomads

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: The Divide tells the story of 7 individuals striving for a better life in themodern day US and UK-where the top 0.1% owns as much wealth as the bottom 90%. By plotting these tales together, we uncover how virtually every aspec tof our lives is controlled by one factor: the size of the gap between rich and poor.

programme.title: The Ettore Majorana Mystery, An Absolute Physicist
programme.desc: The life and genius of Ettore Majorana, remains a source of fascination nearly 80 years after his mysterious disappearance in 1938. This Italian physicist pushed the boundaries of Quantum Physics and Cosmology and made a huge contribution to the understanding of the Nucleus, dark matter and its disappearance. As Science and History are intimately linked, could this be one of the reasons for Majorana's disappearance? An investigative novel and a scientific thriller in troubled decade of the 1930's in a world of the birth of the Atomic bomb.

programme.title: Oh, Dior!
programme.desc: Sabbatical Entertainment's exclusive original documentary admires Christian Dior, the famous French fashion designer whose post-World War II creations were wildly popular and whose legacy continues to influence the fashion industry.

programme.title: Crazy For Madonna
programme.desc: A biography of a universal icon of music and Hollywood, Madonna, better known as the Queen of Pop. Sabbatical Entertainment celebrates Madonna's illustrious career spanning more than four decades, always pushing the boundaries of entertainment. Not afraid of controversy, the Material girl, through her talents, redefined and reshaped pop culture history.

programme.title: Life Is One
programme.desc: The return to life in the wild for 3 captive sun bears.

programme.title: Life Is One
programme.desc: The return to life in the wild for 3 captive sun bears.

programme.title: Salty Love
programme.desc: Salty Love is an underwater story of love and how marine life has found ingenious ways to reproduce. From the magic of coral spawning, the dance of the manta ray, the bond of marine mammals, the dedication of the male sea horse, the labour of love by sea turtles there are so many amazing underwater relationships.

programme.title: Andalusia: The Moorish Architecture
programme.desc: Andalusia, the Spanish territory has a confluence of cultures which is represented in its architecture! Visigothic, Roman, Byzantine and Arab _ the structures in the region display all these influences. Between 8th & 15th century, several dynasties from Arab to Berber conquered Andalusia impacting the way of life of people. The film tells this story through beautiful edifices of Andalusia.

programme.title: In the Darkness
programme.desc: An immersion in the heart of the biggest West-African prison: Abidjan. Located out of sight at the border of the Banco forest, this prison host 5,000 inmates but has capacity for 1,500. With the inmates' help, life inside is organized, and a degree of stability exists.

programme.title: Exoplanets, Thousands Of New Worlds
programme.desc: Are we alone in the universe? This question has been one of the greatest mysteries of all time. 20 years ago, individual scientists began to challenge traditional planetary science as they set off to seek, observe and reveal the existence of unknown worlds: EXOPLANETS. The film recounts the epic journey of these astrophysicists, who turned our knowledge of the universe upside down, in their quest for extraterrestrial life.

programme.title: Last Call for Titan
programme.desc: Join this immersive journey to one of the last unchartered planet of our solar system, the sixth and largest moon of Saturn : TITAN. 12 years ago, after a 7-year-long interplanetary journey the Cassini-Huygens spacecraft marked history with the first landing ever accomplished in the outer Solar system, reaching Titan's surface. Based on the observations and data collected by the probe and the orbiter all through these years this film uses the latest light and sound simulation techniques to interpret visually for the first time the spectacle which has been hiding behind Saturn's dust cloud.

programme.title: Teros
programme.desc: TEROS is a documentary film that tells the story of Los Teros, the team that defends Uruguay national team, which is the only amateur team competed in the Rugby World Cup 2015 held in England. This group of athletes trains day after day while facing their daily professional duties. Professionals from different careers, students and workers make up a group that trains as professionals in spite of being amateurs. Based on effort, they qualified for the Rugby World Cup 2015, and played against the best.

programme.title: Amia
programme.desc: On July 18th1994 in Buenos Aires, the headquarters of the Argentine Israelite Mutual Association AMIA, was destroyed by a car bomb. The blast killed more than 80 victims. Why, fifteen years later, are the web of alliances between Islamic Terrorism and its local connections in Buenos Aires still hidden in the darkness of conspiracy and impunity?

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: And we're off! We learn the history of the world famous Kentucky Derby. Then, call your shot as we learn about one of America's most famous brands, Louisville Slugger. Also, we zip line in the world's only underground zip line attraction and visit the Ali Center.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: The Saints come marching in as we tour the iconic St. Louis Cathedral and the mysterious Ursuline Convent in New Orleans. We delve into Mardi Gras history at Mardi Gras World and visit the National WWII Museum's world class collection.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling coho at Calvert Island and on a big Chinook Salmon quest Southbound around Cape Caution and Port Hardy!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia _ the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature _ the weedy sea dragon _ a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin _ the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world _ the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters _ albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

It's a geologic phenomenon where one side is a rainforest full of colorful birds and strange monkeys and the other, a large lake centered on a vast plain. Two bordering eco-zones…double the wildlife.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: If it's rhinos you want to see, you must visit Hluhluwe-Imfolozi Wildlife Park. This huge wilderness area has the highest density of rhino in the world. In addition to the rhino, we locate a pride of lions that is truly amazing. Mkuze National Park is a treasure trove of rare antelope and various other big game. Best of all, there is often no other guests, so this is one of Africa's best hidden gems.

programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Meanwhile, rich kids in the city attend private English schools to improve their chances to study abroad. But China's favorite philanthropist Chen Guang Biao shares his rags-to-riches story proving that odds can indeed be beaten. Rural children in China may still dream small, but as for the young elite partying away in rooftop bars, life is sweet.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: Napoleon Bonaparte _ Military genius and builder, he will then reign, without any intention to share his position, for over a decade and will engage, with his troupes, in many battles. His imperial army, which has reached 700 000 men, is considered in 1815, the greatest one in the world.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.desc: Westward ho! We settle in Salt Lake City, where we learn about Bringham Young's settlement of the Utah territory and his monument at This is the Place Park. Then we dig in the dirt to find hundreds of perfectly preserved dinosaurs at the Utah Natural History museum. We'll take a look at some US aviation history at the Hill Air force Base museum, and see how life was like for the Utah pioneers at Frontier Homestead State Park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: TTH heads to the great white North…kind of. We visit the world class city of Toronto. There we'll head straight up the Western Hemisphere's tallest structure, the CN Tower. Next we score a look at the Hockey Hall of Fame and see a North American castle at Casa Loma. Finally we see how the British defended their city against the newly formed United States at Fort York.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Around the globe, thousands of decommissioned naval vessels rot in dockyards. What can you do with these toxic time bombs? One solution is to clean them well, blow them up and sink them! Providing shelter and breeding grounds, countless fish and invertebrates colonize steel hulls. In the Cayman Islands, the USS Kittiwake met a watery grave and quickly transformed into a vibrant artificial reef. In the Florida Keys, dozens of purposely sunk ships are a beacon to marine life, and to scuba divers. It seems like a win-win-win situation _ for the environment, for divers and for cash strapped governments. But supporters face tough opposition on many fronts. After years of struggle, Canada's newest artificial reef project _ the HMCS Annapolis, is nearing completion. But will protesters get their way and scuttle the sinking?

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins an expedition to recruit a new Blue World camera operator in the form of a 1,000 pound Tiger shark! Working with experienced shark handlers, he puts a camera on the dorsal fin of the shark to see what it can film all by itself. But will Jonathan get his camera back? Next, he joins an experienced cave diver to explore a famous underwater cave in Northern Florida (USA).

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Cave diving is the most difficult and dangerous type of diving, so the training to become a certified cave diver is arduous. This episode documents Jonathan's actual cave training in the Bahamas and follows him as he learns how to dive safely in the overhead environment of a cave in an attempt to earn his full cave diver certification.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Radar accurate eyes survey the land, slotted feathers adjust flight paths as falcons attack, pelicans soar, kestrels hover, owls silently fly, parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Which is the true Master of the Sky? Peregrine Falcon _ Revered for speed and power, this raptor was favored by ancient falconers. Budgie _ Bright green and yellow budgies light up Australia's skies in lively flocks. Wedge-tailed Eagle _ Australia's largest bird of prey commands awe with its soaring presence. Pelican _ Graceful giants of the sky, pelicans glide in formation on rising thermals. Seabirds _ Nearly 300 species live between sea and air, truly free in their vast domain. Barn Owl _ Mysterious and wise, the barn owl watches silently from the shadows. Vulture _ Africa's plains are scanned by vultures, nature's cleanup crew. Nankeen Kestrel _ Australia's smallest falcon, elegant and inquisitive, glides over open land.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Crocodiles, descended from reptiles 250 million years ago, lurk just beneath the waterline, striking fear into prey. Turtles, among the oldest reptiles, use their shells for protection and camouflage across land, freshwater, and sea. Snakes, from rattlesnakes to dwarf pipe snakes, share traits like legless bodies and lidless eyes, relying on sun for warmth. The king cobra's venom can kill an elephant. Lizards escape predators by shedding tails, which regrow differently. For reptiles, cold blood offers a survival edge in the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Sve za 30 minuta
programme.desc: Džejmi pokazuje kako se pravi isijanto testo sa feta sirom i spanaćem. Sprema salate od krastavaca i paradajza, i obloženi sladoled za samo 30 minuta.

programme.title: Primož Dolničar: Blago iz tegle
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, Primož otkriva arome Mediterana i meša morsku so s letnjim začinima, suvim paradajzom i pokazuje kako se čuvaju tokom zime. Od paradajza priprema pesto, a zatim, pravi džem od šljiva. Sa ovim sastojcima, poslužuje zečetinu i njoke.

programme.title: Primož Dolničar: Blago iz tegle
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi Primož priprema kisela, zimska jela. Ukiseliće krastavce, cvekle i ostalo povrće. Zatim, priprema kremasti namaz od pečenog povrća, koji se čuva u tegli. Potom priprema pečenje od svinjskih rebara sa ljutim čili sosom "Ala Primož".

programme.title: Mark Morijarti: Kuvajte kao profesionalac
programme.desc: Nagrađivani kuvar Mark poziva gledaoce da preispitaju način na koji kuvaju kod kuće. Zaboravite na ideju da odlična hrana zahteva beskrajne sastojke ili sate u kuhinji. Mark pokazuje da svako može da napravi jela dostojna restorana u svojoj kuhinji.

programme.title: Mark Morijarti: Kuvajte kao profesionalac
programme.desc: Nagrađivani kuvar Mark poziva gledaoce da preispitaju način na koji kuvaju kod kuće. Zaboravite na ideju da odlična hrana zahteva beskrajne sastojke ili sate u kuhinji. Mark pokazuje da svako može da napravi jela dostojna restorana u svojoj kuhinji.

programme.title: Put začina: Šejn Delija
programme.desc: U Mesopotamiji su pre nekoliko hiljada godina nastali temelji savremene bliskoistočne kuhinje. Šejn putuje u Tursku, do izvora reka Eufrat i Tigar. Arome i jela koja će ovde otkriti nisu ni blizu ostalim jelima koja je probao u Turskoj.

programme.title: Put začina: Šejn Delija
programme.desc: Šejn putuje na sever do obale Crnog mora, u grad Trabzon. Kuvar je u potrazi za posebnom ribom, evropskim inćunom, kao i receptima koji odaju kulinarsku počast ovoj maloj ribici. Prelazeći Pontijske planine, Šejn će istražiti tipičnu lokalnu kuhinju.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Sve za 30 minuta
programme.desc: Džejmi sprema salatu od patke sa komadićima hleba i u puding od pirinča ubacuje dinstano voće.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Sve za 30 minuta
programme.desc: Džejmi Oliver pokazuje kako se sprema pirinač sa pečurkama i salatom od spanaća. Džejmi pravi i brzi čizkejk od limuna i malina za samo 30 minuta.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Džejmi kod kuće
programme.desc: Džejmi Oliver radi ono što najbolje zna, kuva kod kuće. Recepti će biti jednostavni, sastojci pristupačni, uključujući voće i povrće koje je počeo da uzgaja u svojoj bašti. Svaka epizoda se fokusira na jedan glavni sastojak.

programme.title: Mikelina toskanska kuhinja
programme.desc: Mikela Čapa vraća se u kuhinju i sprema klasična italijanska jela, inspirisana njenim putovanjem u Toskanu. Kuvarica istražuje mesare, pijace i restorane u regionu, usput istražujući ukusne lokalne sastojke.

programme.desc: Lora i Stojan postaju pravi mađioničari u kuhinji dok pripremaju pileću čorbu sa orzo pirinčem, omlet s tikvicama i tartlete s kruškama.
